verdict.rationale: Convex has no built-in natural-language console. Instead, natural-language operation runs through external AI agents: the official MCP server gives agents tools to interact with a deployment, with production protected by default. The docs say starting a project is as easy as asking your coding agent, and agent-setup.md and llms.txt help agents work with Convex. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
